title: Ritham — Cycle Tracking & Recovery-Aware Momentum: Design Document
summary: Design doc specifying two opt-in adaptive-suggestion features: cycle tracking and sleep-based Recovery-aware Momentum adjustments.
notes: Titled 'Design Document' with Status: Design draft, which leans DOC/context-only; however it specifies concrete feature behavior, opt-in rules, and an explicit invariants list (Section 3.3) functioning as acceptance criteria, which is stronger PRD signal (requirements/scope for product behavior) than pure prose documentation.
